module_summary: Round-robin arbiter using a one-hot priority pointer and double-width subtract trick; grant locks until accept, then pointer rotates past the winner.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: Registered one-hot grant vector output, copy of gnt_q, held while locked.

anchors.name: prio_q
anchors.why: One-hot round-robin priority pointer, rotated to follow the last grant on accept.

anchors.name: locked_q
anchors.why: Two-state lock: freezes grant until accept_i; drives gnt_valid_o and pointer update.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Per-requester request vector feeding priority search and lock entry.

anchors.name: accept_i
anchors.why: Grant acceptance; releases lock, rotates pointer and clears grant.

anchors.name: dbl_gnt
anchors.why: Double-width masked-subtract priority search result folded into next grant.

groups.name: Priority search
groups.description: Doubled request vector minus priority pointer selects first requester at or after pointer.

groups.name: Grant lock control
groups.description: Lock flag holds grant until accept, then rotates pointer and clears grant.
